criteria.criterion: athena.toml [capabilities.study] sets an uncommented repo_url naming the kunchenguid/firstmate repository and repo_ref = "main".
criteria.evidence: Read in the diff and confirmed by Grep: athena.toml line 85 is `repo_url = "https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate.git"` and line 86 is `repo_ref = "main"`. Both are uncommented and sit inside the [capabilities.study] section. These are the only repo_url/repo_ref lines in the file.

criteria.criterion: The config() helper in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs removes any existing repo_url and repo_ref lines before adding or omitting them, so the with-repo and without-repo cases both work against the real athena.toml.
criteria.evidence: run_pin_tests.rs lines 79-94: the helper splits the include_str! of athena.toml into lines and drops each line whose trimmed start is repo_url or repo_ref. It then inserts the test URL/REF after the header (with_repo) or inserts nothing (without). Both tests passed when I ran them.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: all tests pass, including both run_pin_tests tests.
criteria.evidence: Every test binary reported `test result: ok` with 0 failed. In athena_core, run_pin_tests::a_study_without_a_configured_repository_stops_before_dispatch and run_pin_tests::a_study_pins_once_records_the_commit_and_mounts_it_read_only_for_both_agents both reported ok.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.
criteria.evidence: Clippy finished with no warnings in both forms. Both fmt checks printed nothing.

findings.summary: An earlier CHANGELOG entry still says athena.toml has the keys "as a commented example". The new entry right below it corrects this, so the history stays consistent.
findings.evidence: Grep for 'commented example' matches only CHANGELOG.md:16. The new entry at lines 19-21 states that the keys are now set.

findings.summary: The helper drops lines by key prefix anywhere in the file, not only in [capabilities.study]. A future key such as repo_url_mirror, or the same key in another section, would be silently removed.
findings.evidence: The filter is `key.starts_with("repo_url") || key.starts_with("repo_ref")` over every line. D77's Tradeoff states this limitation, and no such keys exist today (Grep found only lines 85-86).

summary: The change passes. It sets `repo_url` to the firstmate repository and `repo_ref = "main"` in the `[capabilities.study]` section of `athena.toml`. The `config()` helper in `run_pin_tests.rs` now drops any `repo_url` or `repo_ref` lines from the real `athena.toml` before adding its own, so the duplicate-key failure from the earlier attempt can no longer happen. I ran `cargo test`, `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo fmt --all --check`, and all were clean. Both pin tests passed. The change stays within the listed files and the scope. There are two minor or smaller findings: an older CHANGELOG line still calls the keys a "commented example", and the helper matches keys by prefix, which the decision record already states as a tradeoff.
